tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background; the ground every screen sits on.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Sentence cards, choice options, sheets.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: the alignment strip, the dictation input, unfilled roadmap track.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card edges only; never the only sign of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and option borders (3:1 on paper and paper-raised in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunken, tinte-soft and marker.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Glosses, reasons, captions; on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunken.

tokens.name: tinte
tokens.usage: The brand ink (German: Tinte). The Start button, primary actions, the focus ring, links; as text on paper, paper-raised and tinte-soft.

tokens.name: on-tinte
tokens.usage: Text on a tinte fill (the Start button label). Never literal white in dark.

tokens.name: tinte-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind tinte text: the rule card, a selected option.

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: The highlighter. Fills the ONE changing slot or new chunk in a sentence, nothing else. Always paired with marker-edge.

tokens.name: on-marker
tokens.usage: Text inside a marker fill.

tokens.name: marker-edge
tokens.usage: The 2px underline under a marker slot, so the slot reads at 3:1 without relying on the fill.

tokens.name: again
tokens.usage: Grade Again / a wrong token / an omitted word; as text on paper, paper-raised and again-soft. Always with a word ("Missed", "wrong").

tokens.name: again-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind again text.

tokens.name: hard
tokens.usage: Grade Hard / one minor slip / a flagged word; as text on paper, paper-raised and hard-soft. Always with a word.

tokens.name: hard-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind hard text.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Grade Good / correct. Blue, not green, so it never pairs red–green with again. As text on paper, paper-raised and good-soft.

tokens.name: good-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind good text.

tokens.name: band-1
tokens.usage: Band 1 · Survival on the roadmap. Below 3:1 on paper: always labelled with the band name.

tokens.name: band-2
tokens.usage: Band 2 · Foundations on the roadmap.

tokens.name: band-3
tokens.usage: Band 3 · Everyday life on the roadmap.

tokens.name: band-4
tokens.usage: Band 4 · Threshold on the roadmap.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour; an alias of tinte.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Target language
groups.note: Literata sets every German sentence, so the language being learned always looks the same and never looks like UI.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The wordmark and checkpoint celebrations only.

styles.name: sentence-lg
styles.usage: The sentence being introduced or recalled; one per screen.

styles.name: sentence
styles.usage: Sentences in lists: family lists, one-change pairs, rule examples.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans for the interface; its Arabic companion carries Arabic glosses at the same weight and x-height.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles, the session close headline.

styles.name: gloss
styles.sample: I'd like the bill. · عايز الحساب
styles.usage: The natural translation under a sentence, in ink-muted.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The single number on the session close. Tabular figures.

styles.name: diff
styles.usage: Dictation answers and their token diff.

spacing.note: 4px base. Screens breathe: one task per screen.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-label gap; between a sentence and its slot underline.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; between alignment-strip rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between options; between a sentence and its gloss.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; the screen gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on wider screens; between blocks of a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between the task header and the task.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Around the Start button on the home screen.

radius.note: Index cards, not bubbles: small corners on cards, full pills only for the Start button and audio discs.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, evidence tags, diff tokens, the marker slot.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, choice options, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sentence cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The Start button and audio discs only.

shadow.note: Borders do most of the work; one lift for the card in focus.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The sentence card in focus.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (grade override, recovery plan).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px paper gap, then 2px solid tinte (7:1 on paper light, 8.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: size-tap
tokens.usage: Minimum height of anything tappable.

tokens.name: size-audio
tokens.usage: Audio play disc.

tokens.name: size-start
tokens.usage: Height of the Start button.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length for sentence cards and instructions.
